high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the account "selenagomez," which was posted 4 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The main focus of the post is a close-up image of a person's face, specifically highlighting their eye makeup and lips. The individual has long eyelashes and is wearing dark eyeshadow and mascara. Their lips are painted with a glossy, pinkish-red lipstick. The post includes a "View Post" button, indicating that it is a link to a full post on the Rare Beauty account. The text accompanying the image reads: "Can you guess what's coming?"
